page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 128 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, ensuring dedicated CPU resources without hyperthreading.

This server type is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The absence of local storage and GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, making this instance unsuitable for local-disk-intensive operations or hardware-accelerated graphics and machine learning workloads. However, the high memory capacity combined with dedicated CPU cores and 64 Gbps network bandwidth makes it highly efficient for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, in-memory caching, and enterprise applications requiring substantial RAM density.
